name: folio-assistant-state
title: Folio Assistant (repository state)
description: This repository's own instance: the index's state that is about folio-assistant itself, and nothing a layer owns. Today that is one graph, the repository health report the daily sweep (`health-check.yml`) writes. Each layer keeps its own health graph on its own repository, so the sweep of THIS repository could not store its report anywhere a `GITHUB_TOKEN` scoped to this repository can write (bean folio-assistant-kyrg).
_comment: Owner, 2026-10-22, bean kyrg: option 2 ("keep this sweep's reports in folio-assistant; each layer's own CI writes its own health graph"), shape A (folio-assistant becomes a small local instance with a health graph of its own).

assets.title: AGENTS.md — folio-assistant-state
assets.description: How to work in this instance: its graphs are state branches written by the daily sweep, never edited by hand, and only state about this repository belongs here.

assets.title: folio-assistant-state
assets.description: What this instance is, for a reader: the state this repository keeps about itself, as distinct from what the repository is, which is the root's README.

directories.description: Repository health reports for THIS repository: the one `health-report/v1` document `bun run cat-harness-tools/test/health/run.ts --instance folio-assistant-state` writes in `health-check.yml`. The graph typology is cat-harness's; its `health` entry says what separates a health report (about the repository) from a `qa` verdict (about an artefact).
directories._source_comment: Generated state, kept on its own per-graph branch (owner, 2026-10-03, bean laqs) on THIS repository, so the workflow's own token can write it, and mounted at this path by `bun run cat state:mount`.

_name_comment: Not `folio-assistant`: the reference-direction gate reads an instance's name wherever it appears, and this repository's own name appears in hundreds of cat-harness files.

avatar.reads: a pulse line — the repository's own health, kept by this repository
